'''Kashyyyk ale''' was a type of alcoholic beverage. Supplies of Kashyyyk ale were carried aboard the [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] ''[[Imru Ootmian]]'', to cater to the tastes of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] associates of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a banquet was held in the [[Popara's penthouse|penthouse]] of Zonnos' father [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and Kashyyyk ale was served during the event.
